observations.title: Explore redesigned biome villages
observations.player_action: Visit an improved plains, snow, savanna, desert or taiga village.
observations.outcome: The mod changes village structures and exploration layouts.
conditions: Upstream/native documentation is evidence, not a verified JEM gameplay rule; installed configuration and JEM overrides may differ.
